---
title: "Live demos"
subtitle: "The same warp code as `wxy warp`, compiled to WebAssembly"
---

The demos are hosted from [wxylib/web](https://github.com/wxylib/web).
Every view is a fresh warp: GDAL's chunked warp, kernels and overview
choice, fetching only the COG tiles the view touches over HTTP range
requests.

- [A COG in any projection](https://wxylib.org/web/cog.html): drag to
  pan, scroll to zoom, change the target CRS. Deep links take `?url=` and
  `?crs=`.
- [Sentinel-2 on a web map](https://wxylib.org/web/s2.html): a STAC
  search of the map view, and the chosen scene's raw band COGs warped onto
  the map's own grid. Deep links take `?from=` and `?to=` dates.

```{=html}
<iframe class="demo" src="https://wxylib.org/web/" title="wxylib browser demos" loading="lazy"></iframe>
```

See the [browser how-to](vignettes/browser/README.md) for what the demos
can and cannot do yet.
